title: A Note on Scaling in Randomly Rotated Quantization and Its Connection to the CDEF +1 Pythagorean Relation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantization schemes based on randomized rotations have recently received renewed attention, including the roles of MMSE and unbiased reconstruction scalings. In this note, we point out the connection to classical results in statistical signal processing and communication theory. Specifically, the two reconstruction scales used in the EDEN line of work admit a natural interpretation as finite-dimensional, realization-dependent counterparts of the Wiener and unbiased coefficients in the classical CDEF formulation. At finite blocklength, the CDEF +1 relation holds pointwise for each rotation realization as an exact geometric (Pythagorean) identity, but does not hold after averaging the distortions over the rotation. translated_title: 关于随机旋转量化中缩放因子的注记及其与CDEF +1勾股关系的联系
translated_abstract: 基于随机旋转的量化方案近来重新受到关注，其中包括最小均方误差（MMSE）和无偏重构缩放因子的作用。在本注记中，我们指出了其与统计信号处理和通信理论中经典结果的联系。具体而言，EDEN系列工作中使用的两个重构缩放因子可以被自然地解释为经典CDEF公式中维纳系数和无偏系数在有限维度、依赖具体旋转实现情况下的对应物。在有限块长度下，CDEF +1关系对每一个旋转实现均逐点成立，构成一个精确的几何（勾股/毕达哥拉斯）恒等式，但在对旋转取失真平均后该关系不再成立。经典的信噪比关系 SNR_MMSE = SNR_MMSE,U + 1 在维度 d→∞ 时得以恢复：一旦总体缩放因子被单独处理，随机旋转向量的经验坐标统计特性趋近于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了随机旋转量化中EDEN系列工作的两个重构缩放因子与经典CDEF公式中维纳系数和无偏系数的对应关系，证明CDEF +1勾股关系在有限块长下对每个旋转实现作为精确几何恒等式逐点成立，而经典信噪比关系在维度趋于无穷时恢复。
en_tdlr: This note connects the two reconstruction scalings in EDEN-type randomly rotated quantization to the Wiener and unbiased coefficients of the classical CDEF formulation, showing that the CDEF +1 Pythagorean identity holds pointwise for each rotation realization at finite blocklength, while the classical SNR relation is recovered as the dimension approaches infinity.
